name: Model APIs
description: inference@1 model providers for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages-compatible APIs.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Each entry becomes its own inference provider, keyed by id.

id.title: Provider id
id.description: Unique key sessions pick as { provider, model }.

label.title: Label
label.description: Friendly name in the model picker.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Includes the version path, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

apiKeySecret.title: API key secret
apiKeySecret.description: Secret name (~/.valet/secrets/<name>, then env <NAME>). Omit for keyless local servers.

auth.title: Auth header
auth.description: How the key is sent. Default: bearer for openai, x-api-key for anthropic.

headers.title: Extra headers
headers.description: Merged into every request, e.g. anthropic-beta.

body.title: Request body defaults
body.description: Deep-merged into every request (thinking config, sampling, provider routing).

promptCache.title: Prompt cache
promptCache.description: Anthropic: cache_control on the system prompt and the last message.

utilityModel.title: Utility model
utilityModel.description: Model for side jobs such as session naming. Empty turns them off.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Retries on 408/409/429/5xx/529 and connection errors before the stream starts.

customModels.title: Custom models
customModels.description: Extra models for the picker. The id is sent to the endpoint as is.

models.title: Models
models.description: The picker list. Unset discovers GET <baseUrl>/models. Each model is listed once; effort and fast mode are options.

efforts.title: Efforts
efforts.description: Levels the model takes, lowest first. Chosen via ModelOptions.effort.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: Used when a selection omits effort.

fastByDefault.title: Fast by default
fastByDefault.description: Fast mode is on unless the selection turns it off.
